why: The not-applicable branch: when no instruction file carries the marker there is no claim to hold (invariant I4). Both sides reach it for different reasons. The pass side is a hand-written AGENTS.md with no marker. The fail side has a Markdown file that starts with the marker but is no instruction file (docs/template.md, which no client loads), the way rebar tracks its own template: read every Markdown file and the fail side stops being na.
